notes: Marks are now in the app. A new Academics section: set each class's subjects and what its exams are out of, then enter marks per student, one exam at a time. Jr and Sr KG are graded rather than marked. Marks also show on the Student Profile and in the profile PDF. Student Profile and Collect Payment now say when a student's fee record was last changed and by whom. Left & Graduated can archive a passed-out batch to a folder — documents and a PDF with every mark — and then clear those details from the app; receipts are never touched. Fixed: the months-pending report's grand total now adds up the amount pending.
